origin.description: The caller stores a Dots sequence in _dots. The index is 1-based.
origin.details: A non-positive index, an index past the end, and a caller with no _dots are errors.
origin.example:
bp_...elt <- getFromNamespace("...elt", "backports")
foo <- function(n, ...) bp_...elt(n)
print(foo(n = 2, "a", "b", "c"))
